{{incomplete|needs=Catalogue numbers, disc divisions, containing episodes}} The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the nineteenth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S19|Pokémon the Series: XYZ]], in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Partial collections== Two ''Pokémon the Series: XYZ'' DVD sets were released between 2017 and 2018 by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}, containing the whole season between them. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. ===Set 1=== [[File:XYZ Set 1.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon the Series: XYZ, Set 1]] Pokémon the Series: XYZ, Set 1 was released on August 29, 2017.
